video_title: OG Anunoby, KAT & New York Knicks react to EPIC Game 4 comeback vs. Spurs | 2026 NBA Finals

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown praises Jeremy Sochan's impact in limited minutes
quotes.excerpt: we threw him in the game and he gave us four to five great minutes
quotes.quote: You take a guy like Jeremy Sochan and we threw him in the game and he gave us four to five great minutes. I don't even know when the last time Jeremy really even played longer than 30 seconds. It's just a heck of a job keeping himself ready.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown challenged Karl-Anthony Towns to dominate the offensive glass
quotes.excerpt: as big, as strong, as athletic as he is, he's got to be a monster
quotes.quote: I told Karl-Anthony Towns, as big, as strong, as athletic as he is, he's got to be a monster on the offensive glass tonight.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown calls Karl-Anthony Towns' offensive rebound the biggest play in Knicks history
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if there's a play bigger than any other play in the history of Knicks basketball
quotes.quote: I don't know if there's a play bigger than any other play in the history of Knicks basketball. That was a huge offensive rebound. Huge offensive rebound. He took on the challenge and he went and won the game for us doing exactly what I called him out for doing.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown calls Jalen Brunson an MVP candidate
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is an MVP candidate. I say the same thing about Jalen every game.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is an MVP candidate. I say the same thing about Jalen every game. He does what an MVP is supposed to do and he did it again tonight.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown praises Jose Alvarado's defensive impact and clutch play
quotes.excerpt: Jose Alvarado was unbelievable tonight. He changed the game.
quotes.quote: Jose Alvarado was unbelievable tonight. He changed the game. His speed, his ability to touch the paint. Again, you give San Antonio a lot of credit. They're trying to throw a lot of different things at us defensively, kind of match up man, slash zone. And if you don't close out to Jose as hard as he works on his shot, he's going to make you pay.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown explains the halftime message to the team
quotes.excerpt: I told the guys we could play better. Right now we're letting the ball get to the paint.
quotes.quote: I told the guys we could play better. Right now we're letting the ball get to the paint, and we got to do a better job of keeping the ball out the paint. We got to play faster. So, we're not going to be able to call any plays. We just have to get into our actions right away, keep trying to touch the paint, keep trying to move the ball, keep trying to keep the floor spaced.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the role of luck in sports and life
quotes.excerpt: you got to have a little luck in life. You got to have a little luck in sports.
quotes.quote: You got to have a little luck in life. You got to have a little luck in sports. But you can also go make your own luck, too. So you got to have some natural luck, and then you got to have some luck where you're going to make your own luck.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby reacts to hitting the game-winning shot
quotes.excerpt: Feels cool. I mean, everyone's pretty excited. I'm excited too. We're all excited.
quotes.quote: Feels cool. I mean, everyone's pretty excited. I'm excited too. We're all excited. We're enjoying it right now, but we're just focused on the next game now.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on Mike Brown's halftime challenge
quotes.excerpt: He just told me I need to get on the glass, you know, offensive glass especially.
quotes.quote: He just told me I need to get on the glass, you know, offensive glass especially. Just use my ability, my size, strength, athleticism to make an impact on the glass, and it happened at the end.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on the team's resilience and staying focused
quotes.excerpt: We're a resilient group. We've been through a lot. We've came back plenty of times.
quotes.quote: We're a resilient group. We've been through a lot. We've came back plenty of times when we're down, so just staying with it, weathering the storm, not being too down or angry or getting mad or frustrated, just staying with it.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby describes the game-winning tip-in
quotes.excerpt: I inbound the ball to Jalen. He got a pretty good look and I just went and crash.
quotes.quote: I inbound the ball to Jalen. He got a pretty good look and I just went and crash. Try to get a tip dunk or something. The ball went over my head so I couldn't really dunk it, so I just try to tip it in softly and it went in.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns credits the fans for their support
quotes.excerpt: Shout out to our fans, man. They stuck with us.
quotes.quote: Shout out to our fans, man. They stuck with us. It was an ugly, ugly game. We didn't bring it in the first half, but they stuck with us. They stayed in them seats and they kept cheering for us and they kept finding ways to give us energy.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his fourth-quarter performance
quotes.excerpt: Every time I talk to him, I said, you know, I already know what OG and Jalen is going to do.
quotes.quote: Every time I talk to him, I said, you know, I already know what OG and Jalen is going to do in the fourth quarter. They did exactly what I thought he would do. It gave us a chance to win, and that's all you could ask for from the best two-way player in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's unity and resilience
quotes.excerpt: I've always talked about the unity and connectivity of this team.
quotes.quote: I've always talked about the unity and connectivity of this team. Went in there, people spoke up. Jose, you know, just saying we just got to, regardless of how the result of the game comes out, we can't not at least work on our standards and be who we are.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the importance of experience
quotes.excerpt: Experience teaches you a lot, and I think experience today let us know that we cannot let go.
quotes.quote: Experience teaches you a lot, and I think experience today let us know that we cannot let go of the rope. We always have a chance if we go out there and take it to another level and give ourselves a chance.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the emotional impact of the win
quotes.excerpt: I've seen people leave before the game was over in MSG, watching our MSG network before.
quotes.quote: I've seen people leave before the game was over in MSG, watching our MSG network before. I think for me, you could see my reaction. The emotion kind of spilled out of that moment. It was tears of joy, you know, just, you know, wasn't boo-hoo and anything, but just tears of joy because like I said, all you could do is ask for a chance.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his personal motivation
quotes.excerpt: I just wanted one break in life. I just wanted one thing to go my way one time.
quotes.quote: I just wanted one break in life. I just wanted one thing to go my way one time. And I got one. I got one at that last play with OG making the shot and us getting the stop. I just wanted one break in life, just one thing to go my way one time.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's collective joy
quotes.excerpt: I felt the abundance of joy at one time from everyone at one time.
quotes.quote: I felt the abundance of joy at one time from everyone at one time. The collective joy that came out of everybody for that one moment to hear the buzzer going off and not to see the ball going in the basket. I think we all felt something, like that emotion that was special. It's something that, you know, MSG hasn't had that kind of moment in a long time.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on OG Anunoby's special qualities
quotes.excerpt: You know when you talk about somebody who not only lives up to the moment, but plays with his emotion.
quotes.quote: You know when you talk about somebody who not only lives up to the moment, but plays with his emotion and utilizes that to his advantage, that's a rare quality. A lot of times you play with emotion, but it gets the better of them. And for OG, that emotion is what drives him and makes him take it to another level.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on OG Anunoby's shooting ability
quotes.excerpt: I got to see firsthand when D-Lo acts, couldn't even shoot, and I now know he really can shoot.
quotes.quote: It's a special player. His tenacity, his defensive ability, and his offensive ability that I got to see firsthand when D-Lo acts, couldn't even shoot, and I now know he really can shoot. It's special. He has so much to his basketball game that people don't give credit to.
